summary:
w125 plan written. The r56/r64/r65 scenarios already pass and stay green. The gap: under xdist, a guarantees-only --work-item run left with no test exits 5. The xdist controller never sees the collection-time stash, so work run's merge check refuses the work-item.
Decisions: pytest_sessionfinish decides r65 from the --work-item option, through accepted() and guarantees(), on the controller and on each worker. The GUARANTEES stash is dropped. Only exit 5 becomes 0, so the exit-3 refusals are untouched; mixed work-items keep exit 5.
Files: scripts/work_items.py, tests/scripts/test_work_items.py (a new -n 2 test asserting exit 0). No existing test breaks.
